name: kai-planner
description: Read and edit your personal planner at kaihoward.com/personal — schedule, goals, tasks, and notes.
long_description: Connects Claude to your kaihoward.com/personal planner. Ask about your schedule and have Claude add, reschedule, re-prioritize, rearrange, complete, or delete goals and tasks, and read/update your scratch note. Talks to the Cloudflare Pages API through a Cloudflare Access service token.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Snapshot of the whole planner plus today's items and the note

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Items in a date range, sorted by time

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Edit a goal (rename, reschedule, reprioritize, status)

tools.name: complete_goal
tools.description: Mark a goal done or reopen it

tools.name: move_goal
tools.description: Re-nest a goal under a different parent

tools.name: reorder_goals
tools.description: Set the order of sibling goals

tools.name: delete_goal
tools.description: Delete a goal and its branch

api_key.title: Planner API Key
api_key.description: The KAI_API_KEY for the planner API.

cf_client_id.title: Cloudflare Access Client ID
cf_client_id.description: The Access service-token Client ID (ends in .access).

base_url.title: API Base URL
base_url.description: Planner API base URL. Leave the default unless you know otherwise.
